hemisphere.Description: Side of the trajectory (release folder Left_lobe / Right_lobe)

stn_classification.Description: Classification of the recording depth by the neurophysiologists and surgeons (release folders STN_IN / STN_OUT)

source_depth_label.Description: Release file name (one file per depth). The release does not document the unit or origin of this label; runs are numbered in ascending order of it, per hemisphere.

source_file.Description: Path of the source .mat inside the release data.zip (copy in sourcedata/)

n_samples.Description: Samples in the BrainVision file (= longest channel)

sampling_frequency.Description: Sampling frequency from the release time vector, (N-1)/time[-1]
